blockingIssues.description: apps/api/src/server.ts binds to `process.env.PORT ?? 3100` instead of the mission contract variable `PORT_API`, so the scaffolded API runtime is not aligned with `.factory/init.sh` and `.factory/library/environment.md`.

The referenced completion commit `78b26fd` only adds smoke tests and does not implement the Docker-first execution path, service scripts, environment defaults, or validation harness wiring described by the feature; the actual tooling work appears to predate the assigned feature commit.

packages/db schema and migration files leave several declared entity relationships as plain text columns without SQLite foreign-key enforcement, so downstream features can create orphaned or cross-entity records despite the schema implying durable relational integrity.

packages/db persistence-contract tests only prove thesis scoping and deterministic ordering for a narrow subset of repositories, leaving most thesis-domain repository boundaries unverified despite the feature claiming package-level tests as the downstream contract.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify how platform features should map completion status to commits or worker sessions so scrutiny can trace feature ownership when implementation lands earlier than follow-up coverage commits.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: `platform-docker-toolchain-services` is marked completed by session `9fb04b7e-2a8d-4081-afcc-a6a4bdd29169`, but the referenced commit `78b26fd` only adds smoke tests while the platform scripts and services were introduced in scaffold commit `25e077d`.

rejectedObservations.observation: Runtime entrypoints should consume the same env var names established by `.factory/init.sh` and `.factory/library/environment.md`.
rejectedObservations.reason: already-documented: `.factory/library/environment.md` already records `PORT_API` and `PORT_WEB`; the review surfaced an implementation bug rather than missing shared-state documentation.

rejectedObservations.observation: The repo has no top-level README.md, so worker guidance should point to mission docs or `.factory/library/*` as the actual exploration entrypoint.
rejectedObservations.reason: ambiguous: this comes from global exec guidance rather than milestone-specific shared state, so it should be handled outside this scrutiny synthesis.
